scope: All 86 open issues at the start of this pass. Adds qualifying catalog projects and well-defined requests; records unresolved, duplicate, out-of-scope and insufficient submissions. This is not a full re-audit of unrelated existing catalog projects or of every project in linked third-party directories.
delivery: Draft PR held open. No issue comments, issue state changes, merge or auto-merge in this pass.
limitations: Upstream source, license, README, representative implementation and references were reviewed; no third-party code was executed.
No local tests run. Catalog validator and commit hooks are separate from runtime or browser validation.
New project website/browser URLs remain subject to CI link validation; URL reachability does not certify runtime functionality.
Existing deeper-review and duplicate-resolution ledgers retain earlier evidence and decisions; pending items here do not imply approval.
